land.text: Thebes, which Harsiesi 'captured in the summer of 131 BC', and the south of Upper Egypt
Thebes recaptured by Ptolemy's forces 'in November of the same year' and the southern Upper Egypt after Harsiesi's death, 'likely September 130 BC'

capitals.name: Thebes (Luxor)
capitals.note: The city Harsiesi 'captured ... in the summer of 131 BC'; Ptolemy's forces retook it in November of the same year.

correction.text: Thebes and the southern part of Upper Egypt, 'ruling only in the southern part of Upper Egypt and only for a brief period'

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (no Cliopatria row; the Ptolemaic Kingdom shape of 164-127 holds all of Egypt). The page names only Thebes and the southern part of Upper Egypt: an 80 km circle round Luxor is a reading (Upper Egypt's region is 597,000 km2 with desert and is not used). No area on the page.

correction.text: the south of Upper Egypt without Thebes, retaken in November 131

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: the same circle minus a 15 km circle at Thebes. The page's own dates conflict (Thebes retaken in November 'of the same year' as the summer-131 capture; Harsiesi's death 'likely' September 130), so 130 holds the rump only as a reading.

region.text: Thebes and the south of Upper Egypt

ledger.note: 131 BCE: Harsiesi seizes Thebes and takes pharaonic titles. 'Harsiesi captured Thebes in the summer of 131 BC and likely assumed pharaonic titles'; infobox 'Reign: 131-130 BC'. The page gives no month for the summer.

region.text: Thebes and the south of Upper Egypt

ledger.note: 131 BCE: Thebes passes from the Ptolemaic kingdom to the rebel, in the civil war of Ptolemy VIII and Cleopatra II.
131 BCE: Ptolemy's forces retake Thebes. 'Ptolemy's forces recaptured the city in November of the same year' (the page's sentence after the summer-131 capture).
130 BCE: the rump of the rebel state ends with Harsiesi's death, 'likely' in September 130 BC.
130 BCE: Harsiesi dies, 'which likely occurred in September 130 BC'.

wars.name: Revolt of Harsiesi
wars.outcome: Harsiesi took Thebes in the summer of 131 and 'ruled only in the southern part of Upper Egypt and only for a brief period'; Ptolemy's forces recaptured the city in November; he died 'likely' in September 130.
wars.note: The page does not say which of Ptolemy VIII's and Cleopatra II's forces retook Thebes; the contest over the south is not drawn, as the page gives no zone.

certainty.note: The extent of the rebel state is the southern Upper Egypt of the page; no frontier is given.

sources.title: Harsiesi
sources.note: Reign 131-130, Thebes captured summer 131, retaken November, death likely September 130.

notes: One page (budget 1-2). The page contradicts itself on the end (Thebes retaken in November 'of the same year' against death 'likely' in September 130); both events are recorded. The month of the summer capture is not given, so none is recorded. The Theban revolt of 88-85 BC was asked of the page and is not on it. Cleopatra II's Alexandria (131-127) is the other side of the same civil war.
